theorem accuracy (Tset : modes (Fin n)) (Q₀ : Normal.Symmetric (Fin n × V)) (m : Fin n × V → ℂ)
    (hp : Q₀=Normal.scope (perSlot M) Q) (hμ : m=Normal.reads (perSlot M) μ)
    (h : Sorts Q μ X.B)
    (he : Nearby (ferry Q) (Configuration.currentX hx G d) (μ∘polar) 0 X.B X.collision) :
    ‖blend Q₀ m (pot Tset.val P)- Maxwell.Wick.moment G (Read.portion Tset x) (fun i => Maxwell.observable G d (F ((Read.project Tset) i).val))‖ ≤ X.cost := by
  let Z := Tset.val
  have hZ : Z.card ≤ n := by simpa using card_le_univ Z
  let X' := fun i => thawKey (F i)
  let H := cast M P
  let Y := fun i => rename (Sum.inl : _ → KeyIn G d ⊕ W) (X' i)
  have hz : blend Q₀ m (pot Z P)=blend Q μ (pot Z H) := by
    rw [hp,hμ, ← wets]; apply congr_arg
    unfold pot; rw [map_prod]; exact prod_congr rfl fun i _ => Normal.posts M i (P i)
  have hc i : totalDegree (H i)≤k := (ascent ..).trans (T.words i)
  have hy i : totalDegree (Y i)≤k := by unfold Y X'; rw [← T.mark i]; exact (below_degree ..).trans (hc i)
  have hC i : totalDegree (X' i) ≤ k := le_trans (bracket ..) (hy i)
  rw [hz, Configuration.G_subset hx]; refine (norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ (blend Q μ (pot Z Y)) _).trans ?_
  have hh := zero_lt_one.trans_le he.small.paid; have hD : 0≤ Common.priced X.B (n*k) := by dsimp only [Common.priced]; positivity
  apply le_trans _ X.enough; apply add_le_add
  · rw [← map_sub]; apply (Common.width (pot Z H-pot Z Y) (n*k) h ?_).trans
    · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hD
      have hp : 1 ≤ X.base+X.ξ := X.home.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right X.pos)
      exact (vertices T Z).trans (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hZ) X.pos)
        (pow_le_pow_right₀ hp hZ) (pow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hp) _) (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) X.pos))
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg,show -(pot Z Y)=(-1:ℂ) • (pot Z Y) by simp]; exact (totalDegree_add (pot Z H) _).trans (max_le (ceiling Z H hc) ((totalDegree_smul_le (-1:ℂ) (pot Z Y)).trans (ceiling Z Y hy)))
  · change ‖blend Q μ _-_‖ ≤ _
    rw [show blend Q μ (pot Z Y)=_ from tide Q μ Z X']
    refine (Common.differs (pot Z X') (n*k) he (ceiling Z _ hC)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (mul_nonneg he.pos hD))
    refine (Rise.purchased _ zero_le_one ..).trans ?_
    have hh := prod_le_prod (s:=Z) (fun i _ => Rise.sign _ (post i (X' i)) zero_le_one) (fun i _ => (Rise.port i (X' i)).trans (T.price i))
    rw [prod_const] at hh; exact hh.trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ X.home hZ)

proof_context.conclusion: The Wick moment of the product differs from its Gaussian blend by an explicit cost X.cost built from the factor and pairing bounds.

lemma pedalling (x : Points n) (h : G.Simple) (H : C.Makes) (hb : 0 < b) (hD : saves C d+3 ≤ b) (hx : x∈conf n) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop, Period b w degree x k := by
  let Y:= C.path.levels
  filter_upwards [passing_all h H degree w b hb hD,clockwise degree Y h hb x hx d, Glimmer.accumulate ℕ atTop _ (Read.maxProfile C x (joint w))
    (profile_tends _ _ (Maxwell.table_smooth C.labels) hx (Station.tuning Y x h hb)) Y.clock.hatBeta (Station.hat_rate Y h)] with k h1 h2 h3
  exact ⟨h1,fun hp => ⟨h2 hp,h3⟩⟩

proof_context.conclusion: For b fixed with saves C d+3 <= b, eventually in k the Period condition holds, making the Gaussian comparison error plus s^{-3/2} at most s^{-31/32}.

lemma crushed (hp : Period b w degree x k) (g : Fit C.path.levels b k x) {T' : C.label d→ₗ[ℂ] C.label d} (hV : Heating C k N p d degree V T')
    (t : Fin n→C.label d) (hi : k≤N) (ht : ∀ i, Price.Solves C (Station.mag C.path.levels b k) d k N p T' (w i) (t i))
    (hb : Bell C.path.levels X d degree g) (D : Demand) (slot : ℕ) (h : Clipped b X V c Y x t hi degree D slot) :
    Arrangements hi c Y (joint w) (asked t) g D slot := by
  let A := C.path.levels; let T:= Ship.yard C b hi p; let S := clim A k
  let f:= Ship.targets C (joint w) g
  intro hv hs; obtain ⟨α,β,bα,bβ,H,K,W,h1,hbg,h2,h3,h4⟩ := h hv hs
  refine ⟨α,β,bα,bβ,H,K,W,h1,hbg,h2,fun i => ⟨(h3 i).1,(h3 i).2,fun U HH => ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hh⟩ := h4 i.1 U HH
  obtain ⟨hc,hp⟩ := hp; obtain ⟨Q,L⟩ := hp g
  let u:= Station.choose A b k x
  let D' := Cumulus X u (before A b k) V t y
  have he : ‖D'-f‖+bill (-3/2) S ≤ bill (-31/32) S := L _ _ _ (cumulates X V u (before A b k) t y)
    (Read.cumulative C (Station.tested A b k x) (joint w) (Ship.fitting g)) (fun s => sizes w g degree hi hV hb y hy hc t ht Q s)
  let v:= (W i).value U; let z:= Peak.view T f i; let a:= (Array.reorient T i.1 D').part i.2.val
  change ‖v+z‖ ≤ _
  rw [show v+z=(a+z)+(v-a) by ring]; exact (norm_add_le ..).trans ((add_le_add (honor (C:=C) i.1 _ _ i.2) (hh _)).trans he)

proof_context.conclusion: Under Period, the source value error is bounded by honor plus the cumulant error, giving the required source bound.
